units.source_text: 阿清病倒的事，村里人很快就传扬开来。

en.t: The news that A-Qing had fallen ill quickly spread through the village.

units.source_text: 从今年夏天起，她几乎每天都背着妓馆的婴儿，拉着一个四岁小女孩的手，

en.t: Since the summer of that year, almost every day she carried the baby from the brothel on her back and held the hand of a four-year-old girl,

units.source_text: 从山谷登上沿街的村庄。

en.t: climbing up from the valley to the village along the road.

units.source_text: 一路上还有三四个幼儿聚在她身边。

en.t: Along the way, three or four other little children would gather around her.

units.source_text: 她带着孩子，一副苍白的长脸，头上整整齐齐梳理着左右两个发髻，显得又温厚又凄凉。

en.t: With the children beside her, her long pale face and the two neat side buns in her hair made her look both gentle and forlorn.

units.source_text: 村里人同她照面，总是先向她招呼。

en.t: Whenever the villagers met her, they were always the first to greet her.

units.source_text: 她尽管经常卧病在床……也许正是由于经常卧病在床，

en.t: Although she was often confined to bed by illness... or perhaps precisely because she was often confined to bed,

units.source_text: 她的头发总是梳理得两鬓没有一丝短发。

en.t: her hair was always combed so carefully that not a single stray short hair showed at her temples.

units.source_text: 她是个沉默寡言的人，但孩子们都很愿意亲近她，

en.t: She was a quiet woman of few words, yet the children were all eager to be near her,

units.source_text: 人们不免觉得惶惑：她同孩子们都说了些什么呢？

en.t: and people could not help wondering: what did she say to the children?
